source: 680 Combat Experience
target: 680 Experientia Pugnandi

source: Camus, who had just loaded the Purifying Bullets into his revolver cylinder, heard a sharp sound of static in his mind.
target: Camus, qui modo globulos purificantes in cylindrum revolverii sui oneraverat, sonitum acutum staticum in mente audivit.

source: Before his eyes, the world seemed to separate from him, a chunk of transparent glass forming a barrier between him and reality.
target: Ante oculos eius, mundus videbatur se ab eo separare, cum fragmentum vitrei perspicui, quod inter eum et rem veram, ut obstaculum, constituisse videbatur.

source: Under the Wraith’s Shriek, cracks appeared on the glass, extending into the Spirit Body.
target: Sub ululatu umbrae, fissurae in vitreo apparuerunt, quae in corpus spirituale se extendebant.

source: A faint shattering sound reverberated in the ears of Lumian, Rhea, Lugano, Amandina, Robert, who had just crawled out of the ground near the altar, and the other naked men frantically dodging.
target: Tenue sonitum confringentem per auribus resonabat Lumiani, Rheae, Lugani, Amandinae, Roberto, qui modo ex terra prope aram emergerant, atque aliorum virorum nudorum, qui furiose effugiabant.

source: It brought sharp pain to their eardrums, blood to their noses, and agony from the depths of their souls.
target: Illud intulit acutum dolorem ad tympana eorum, sanguinem ad naribus eorum, et cruciatum ex imis animorum profundis.

source: Almost everyone froze in place, like fragile porcelain caught in an invisible storm.
target: Fere omnes in loco steterunt immobiles, velut fragilis porcellana in tempestate invisibili capta.

source: The naked men, who appeared ordinary, fainted without a sound.
target: Viri nudi, qui ordinarii apparuerunt, sine sonitu conciderunt.

source: Blood seeped from their eyes, nostrils, mouths, ears, and skin.
target: Sanguis ex oculis, naribus, ore, auribus, et cute eorum stillavit.

source: However, Lumian, who had advanced to Sequence 5 Reaper, suffered the least damage and recovered the fastest.
target: Tamen, Lumian, qui ad Sequentiam 5 Messoris pervenit, minimas laesiones passa est atque celerrime restitutus est.

source: Thin ice crystal arrows shot at him, their arrowheads flickering with a cold light.
target: Tenues sagittae crystallinae glaciei in eum volaverunt, quarum acuminibus luce frigido micabantibus.

source: In an instant, Lumian made a decision.
target: Statim, Lumian consilium cepit.

source: He didn’t transform into a shadow creature or enter the shadows to dodge the damage, nor did he attempt to duck.
target: Non se mutavit in creaturam umbrarum nec in umbras se contulit ut laesionem evitare, neque conatus est se flectere.

source: Instead, blazing white flames ignited over his body.
target: Contra, flammae candidae ardentes super corpus eius incenderunt.

source: He transformed into a burning-white spear and hurled himself towards the stained‑glass window closer to the door, facing the ice crystal arrows.
target: Se transformavit in hastam albanter ardentem et se projecit versus fenestram vitream pictam prope ostium, adversus sagittas crystallinas glaciei.

source: Padre Cali, with his dark brown skin and sinister expression, stood there.
target: Padre Cali, cum cute fusca et vultu sinistro, ibi stabat.

source: Amandina was the second to recover from the Wraith’s Shriek.
target: Amandina secunda fuit quae ex ululatu umbrae se recuperavit.

source: She witnessed the majestic blazing‑white flaming spear collide with the ice crystal arrows hurtling towards them.
target: Ea conspexit hastam majesticam albanter ardentem, quae sagittas crystallinas glaciei in ipsos volitantibus concurrere videbatur.

source: Silently, a portion of the ice crystal arrows facing the blazing‑white flaming spear evaporated into sizzling white gas, while the surrounding ones quickly melted and turned to steam.
target: Silentio, pars sagittarum crystallinarum glaciei, quae contra hastam albanter ardentem erant, in gas album sibilans evanuit, dum reliquae celeriter liquefactae et in vaporum conversae sunt.

source: White mist caused by water steam filled the air.
target: Nebula alba, a vaporibus aquae orta, aerem implevit.

source: Although the blazing white flaming spear had dimmed significantly and stopped burning violently, it still pierced through and headed straight for the stained‑glass that revealed Padre Cali’s figure.
target: Etsi hasta albanter ardens candida significanter attenuata et violentissime non iam ardebat, tamen pervenit et recta versus vitream pictam, qua figura Padre Cali patebat, properavit.

source: Similar ice crystal arrows pierced through the white mist, striking Amandina, Camus, Rhea, and Lugano.
target: Sagittae crystallinae glaciei similes per nebulam albam penetraverunt, percutientes Amandinam, Camum, Rheam, et Luganon.

source: However, they either melted or shrunk significantly, reducing their speed.
target: Tamen vel liquefactae sunt vel signanter contractae, ita celeritatem minuentes.

source: Amandina and Camus, who had just escaped the Wraith’s Shriek, easily dodged.
target: Amandina et Camus, qui modo ex ululatu umbrae effugerant, facile evitaverunt.

source: Although Rhea and Lugano couldn’t react in time and were hit by the ice crystal arrows, they only felt a slight pain, as if a child had hit them with a snowball.
target: Quamquam Rhea et Lugano non tempestive reagere potuerunt et sagittae crystallinae glaciei illos percusserunt, tantum levem dolorem sensit, quasi puer eis pila nivis intulisset.

source: It was a little painful, but mostly wet and cold.
target: Parum dolorosum erat, sed praecipue madidum et frigidum.

source: They seized the opportunity to snap out of their daze, almost at the same time as Robert at the altar.
target: Occasionem ceperunt se evigilare ex stupore, paene simul cum Roberto ad aram.

source: Crack!
target: Crepitus!

source: The blazing‑white flaming spear struck the stained‑glass, shattering it into countless pieces. However, Padre Cali had already leaped onto the window that Lumian had pried open, narrowly escaping the attack.
target: Hasta albanter ardens percussit vitream pictam, eam in innumeras partes confringens. Tamen, Padre Cali iam in fenestram quam Lumian aperuerat insiluit, anguste impetum evadens.

source: As the flames of the burning white spear dissipated, Lumian’s figure emerged from the fading light.
target: Dum flammas hastae albanter ardentis evanuerunt, figura Lumiani ex luce evanescente apparuit.

source: Without hesitation, he ignited white flames once more, transforming into a majestic spear that shot towards the window where Padre Cali had appeared, determined to pursue his enemy.
target: Sine mora, iterum flammas albas incendit, se transformans in hastam majesticam, qua versus fenestram, ubi Padre Cali apparuerat, volens hostem persequi, iecit.

source: He deliberately refrained from teleporting and repeatedly transformed into a flaming spear, hoping to lull Padre Cali into overlooking such possibilities. Then, at a critical moment, he would unexpectedly appear beside him and use the Spell of Harrumph, catching the Wraith off guard.
target: Deliberate se abstinuit teletransportare et iterum atque iterum in hastam flammans se transformabat, sperans ut Padre Cali has facultates negligere; deinde, in momento critico, inopinanter iuxta eum appareret et Incantationem “Harrumph” adhiberet, ita Wraith insidiatus capiens.

source: Otherwise, it would be challenging to catch a Wraith that could constantly jump through mirrored objects, using them as portals to evade capture.
target: Alioquin difficile esset comprehendere Wraith, qui constanter per specula saliret, ea uti portis ad capturam evitandam.

source: Furthermore, Lumian knew that Wraiths could be considered spirit world creatures to a certain extent. They could also use the spirit world to complete teleportation, although they couldn’t compare to spirit world creatures specialized in this area. Nevertheless, it wasn’t an ability to be underestimated.
target: Praeterea, Lumian sciebat Wraith esse creaturas ex mundo spirituali ad quandam partem. Possent etiam mundum spiritualem uti ad teleportationem peragendam, quamvis creaturis mundi spiritualis, in hac re specializatis, non comparari possent. Nihilominus, illa facultas non erat subestimanda.

source: As the fireball spear hurtled toward the window Lumian had pried open, Robert rolled to the side of the altar where their clothes were, intending to retrieve the ingredients used for spirit channeling.
target: Cum hasta globularis ignis versus fenestram, quam Lumian aperuerat, volabat, Robert ad latus arae, ubi vestimenta erant, se volvit, intendens ingrediens ad spiritum canalizandum recipere.

source: Swoosh!
target: Swoosh!

source: An arrow pierced the stone bricks in front of him, forcing him to change the direction of his roll at the last moment, narrowly avoiding the projectile.
target: Sagitta percussit latera lapidea coram eo, faciens ut directionem volutionis suae in ultimo momento mutaret, anguste proiectum vitans.

source: As soon as Rhea regained her composure, she aimed at Robert and launched an attack.
target: Statim postquam Rhea suam temperationem recuperavit, in Robertum destinavit et impetum iniit.

source: Both she and Camus believed that Louis Berry could handle Padre Cali on his own, so their mission was to restrain Robert and capture this key figure, preventing him from interfering in the battle.
target: Et illa et Camus crediderunt Louis Berry posse Padre Cali solus administrare; ergo eorum munus erat Robertum retinere et hanc personam clavem capere, ne in pugnam interveniret.

source: As a gunshot rang out, Padre Cali’s figure vanished from the stained‑glass window, leaving no trace of his presence.
target: Dum sclopetum acutum sonabat, figura Padre Cali ex fenestra vitrea picta evanuit, nullum vestigium praesentiae eius relinquens.

source: The eyes of Amandina, who was nearby, reflected the image of the naked fallen padre.
target: Oculi Amandinae, quae prope erant, imaginem Padri Cali, nudum atque lapsum, reflexerunt.

source: Amandina wanted to resist, but her body quickly turned cold, gradually defying her will as an unknown force took control of her actions.
target: Amandina resistere voluit, sed corpus eius celeriter frigide factum est, paulatim voluntati eius repugnans, dum vis ignota actiones eius regere coepit.

source: Amidst the sloshing sounds, Lumian’s blazing‑white flaming spear pierced through the stained‑glass and landed outside the cathedral, three to four meters away from Amandina, its heat radiating in the cool night air.
target: Inter sonos liquefactionis, hasta albanter ardens Lumiani per vitream pictam penetravit et extra cathedral cecidit, tres ad quattuor metra a Amandina, calor eius in aere frigido nocturno radiante.

source: As the flames dissipated, Lumian appeared, clad in a golden straw hat, a white shirt, and a black vest.
target: Dum flammas evanuerunt, Lumian apparuit, indutus pileum stramineum aureum, tunicam albam, et loricam nigrum.

source: At that moment, Amandina’s hands had already “involuntarily” risen.
target: Illo momento, manus Amandinae iam “involuntarie” surrexerant.

source: The corners of her beautiful face curled into a sinister and smug smile.
target: Anguli faciei eius pulchrae in risum sinistrum et superbum contraxerunt.

source: Come on!
target: Age!

source: Attack me!
target: Oppugna me!

source: Amandina would be the first to be injured and die.
target: Amandina fore prima vulnerata et mortua.

source: If the body can’t protect me, I can still jump and shift positions in time!
target: Si corpus me non defendere potest, adhuc saltare et positiones mutare in tempore possum!

source: Padre Cali was wary of Amandina’s ability to forcefully pull people into dreams, a power that could easily turn the tide of battle.
target: Padre Cali de facultate Amandinae, qua vi homines in somnia trahere poterat, cautus erat, potentia quae facile cursum belli mutare posset.

source: This time, he chose to possess her instead of Louis Berry, an enemy at a higher Sequence, hoping to use her as a shield against Lumian’s attacks.
target: Hoc tempore, elegit eam possidere pro Louis Berry, hoste in Sequentia superiori, sperans eam uti ut scutum contra impetum Lumiani.

source: As Padre Cali manipulated Amandina’s body with a sinister and smug smile, he saw Louis Berry’s lips curve into a radiant smile.
target: Dum Padre Cali corpus Amandinae, cum risu sinistro et superbo, moderabatur, vidit labia Louis Berry in risum radiantem incurvare.

source: As a Wraith, Padre Cali had a strong spiritual premonition, and he suddenly sensed extreme danger.
target: Ut Wraith, Padre Cali validam praemonitionem spiritualem habebat, et subito extremum periculum sensit.

source: “Ha!”
target: «Ha!»

source: A pale‑yellow light burst forth from Lumian’s laughter and landed on Amandina, who stood three to four meters away, enveloping her spirit and Padre Cali, who couldn’t use Mirror Blink in time.
target: Lumen pallidum flavum e risu Lumiani erupit et in Amandina cecidit, quae tres ad quattuor metra distante stabat, includens spiritum eius et Padre Cali, qui tempore “Mirror Blink” uti non poterat.

source: Lumian honestly found it a pleasant surprise.
target: Lumian id vere iucundum inopinatum invenit.

source: You know about Nightmare’s abilities, but don’t you know how to guard against the Spell of Harrumph?
target: Scis de facultatibus Nightmare, sed nesne quomodo contra Incantationem “Harrumph” te tueri possis?

source: Oh, you really don’t. You don’t know this ability, nor do you know that I’m capable of it.
target: O, vere non nosti. Non nosti hanc facultatem neque scis me id efficere posse.

source: However, as a Wraith, you can continuously “mirror‑jump,” yet you insist on attaching yourself to one of my teammates and remain within a few meters of me. What kind of belief is this?
target: Tamen, ut Wraith, constanter “saltum speculare” facere potes, sed insistis te ad unum ex sodalibus meis affigere et intra paucos metra a me manere. Quae talis opinio est?

source: Don’t you have enough combat experience?
target: Nonne satis experientiae pugnae tibi est?

source: Even if you didn’t know the Spell of Harrumph, you have to guard against abilities like Psychic Piercing!
target: Etiamsi Incantationem “Harrumph” nescires, contra facultates similes “Psychic Piercing” te tueri oportet!

source: Oh, you think Camus is far away, so there’s no need to worry about it. As a Sequence 5 of the Hunter pathway, how would I know this? Are you hoping to use me to quickly kill Amandina?
target: O, putas Camum longe esse, itaque nihil sollicitum esse. Ut Sequentia 5 Venatoris, quomodo id scirem? Sperasne ut me ad celeriter Amandinam interficiendam adhibeas?

source: Haven’t you considered the existence of mystical items?
target: Numquid existentiam rerum mysticarum non consideravisti?

source: My original plan was if I failed to finish you off after using teleportation to deliver the Spell of Harrumph and Cull, I would feign a strategic retreat and find a small space to set up the Bottle of Fiction. Then, when you caught up, I would fight you in a cramped and sealed space, just like how I dealt with Hisoka back then. To my surprise, you delivered yourself to me…
target: Consilium meum originale erat: si te post teletransportationem ad mittere Incantationem “Harrumph” atque “Cull” interficere deficerem, simulare reditum strategicum atque parvum spatium invenirem ad “Bottle of Fiction” instituendum. Deinde, cum te assequerer, te in angusto et clauso spatio pugnarem, sicut cum Hisoka tunc egissem. Ad meum stuporem, te mihi tradidisti…

source: As Lumian criticized wildly, Padre Cali and Amandina fainted and collapsed to the ground.
target: Dum Lumian vehementer reprehendebat, Padre Cali et Amandina evanuerunt et in terram corruerunt.

source: Had it been during his battle with Hisoka some time ago, Lumian would have hastened to follow through with the subsequent steps. This was because the Spell of Harrumph couldn’t render a Sequence 5 enemy unconscious for long. However, now that he had advanced to Sequence 5, his Spell of Harrumph had become significantly stronger. The time he could control a Wraith had increased, although it was still limited to a few seconds.
target: Si hoc aliquantum ante tempore in proelio cum Hisoka factum fuisset, Lumian celerius se ad gradus subsequentes perducere festinasset. Nam Incantatio “Harrumph” hostem Sequentiae 5 non diu inanimatum facere poterat. Tamen, nunc quod ad Sequentiam 5 pervenit, incantatio eius signanter fortior facta est, et tempus quo Wraith regere posset auxit, quamvis adhuc paucis secundis limitatum esset.

source: Lumian retrieved a few special bullets from his Traveler’s Bag. They had been purchased through Camus from the patrol team.
target: Lumian paucos globulos especiales ex sacco Viatoris sui recepit. Illi per Camum a manipulo speculatorum empti fuerant.

source: Two Exorcism and two Purification Bullets, both golden in color.
target: Duo globuli Exorcismi et duo globuli Purificationis, ambo aurei colore.

source: Lumian swiftly loaded the four bullets into the cylinder of his revolver and aimed at Amandina, who lay on the ground.
target: Lumian celeriter quattuor globulos in cylindrum revolverii sui oneravit et in Amandinam destinavit, quae in terra iacebat.

source: Catching sight of this from the corner of his eye, Camus jumped in fright and shouted, “What are you doing?”
target: Hoc ex angulo oculi intuens, Camus ex timore saltavit et clamavit: “Quid agis?”

source: “Saving her,” Lumian replied calmly.
target: “Eam servare,” Lumian tranquille respondit.

source: Then, he pulled the trigger.
target: Deinde, manubrium premuit.

source: Bang!
target: Bang!

source: The golden Exorcism Bullet struck Amandina’s shoulder, causing her to bleed and emit a golden sunlight.
target: Globulus aureus Exorcismi Amandinae umerum percussit, causans ut sanguis effunderet et lumen aureum emisset.

source: Amandina woke up in pain, and the apparition of Padre Cali detached from her body, his face warped under the “sunlight.”
target: Amandina dolore excitata est, et phantasma Padri Cali a corpore eius separatum est, cum facie sub luce aurea distorta.

source: Originally, with the strength of the Exorcism Bullets, it would have been impossible to expel a Wraith from the victim’s body in an instant. However, Padre Cali was unconscious and unable to react effectively.
target: Primum, cum virtute globulorum Exorcismi, impossibile fuisset in uno momento Wraith ex corpore victimae expellere. Attamen, Padre Cali inanimatus erat et efficaciter reagere non poterat.

source: Lumian raised his gun, his eyes reflecting the color on the surface of Padre Cali’s Spirit Body. He locked onto the pallor that had become evident.
target: Lumian sclopetum suum attulit, oculi coloris in superficie Corporis Spirituali Padri Cali reflexi; illud pallorem notum intendit.

source: Bang!
target: Bang!

source: A golden Purifying Bullet, imbued with Cull’s power, struck the Wraith’s forehead.
target: Globulus aureus Purificationis, potestate Cull imbutus, frontem Wraith percussit.

source: The apparition of Padre Cali froze as he “saw” the bullet shatter on its own, transforming into balls of golden holy flames that spread throughout his body, igniting dust and his soul.
target: Apparitio Padri Cali immobilis fuit, dum “vidit” globulum seipso confringere, in globulos flammarum sacrarum aurearum transformari, qui per totum corpus eius se diffuserunt, pulverem atque animam eius inflammantes.

source: The bright, sun‑like golden flames swiftly enveloped Padre Cali, causing him to let out a tragic scream.
target: Flammae aureae, similes radiis solis, celeriter Padrem Cali involverunt, facientes eum clamorem tragicum emittens.

source: This wasn’t a Wraith Shriek, but it still made everyone’s heads and ears hurt.
target: Hoc non erat ululatus Wraith, sed tamen omnibus capitibus et auribus dolorem inferebat.

source: Lumian endured these sensations and calmly said to Amandina,
target: Lumian has sensus sustinuit et tranquille Amandinae dixit:

source: “Drag him into a dream and inquire about the source of the Dream Festival.”
target: «Trahe eum in somnium et interroga de fonte Festi Somniorum.»

source: Padre Cali had already been subjected to Cull and was severely weakened, teetering on the brink of true death. Amandina could effectively restrain him!
target: Padre Cali iam Cull subiectus erat et graviter debilitatus, in limine veri mortis versans. Amandina eum efficaciter retinere poterat!

source: “But…” Amandina’s shoulder and head ached, but she didn’t dare complain when she saw Louis Berry’s cold and calm expression.
target: «Sed…» umerus et caput Amandinae dolebant, sed non audebat queri cum vidit vultum frigidum et tranquillum Louis Berry.

source: Lumian turned to Lugano and said, “Treat her gunshot wound.”
target: Lumian ad Luganon se vertit et dixit: “Curare vulnera eius ex sclopeto!”

source: “Alright.” Lugano winced from the pain in his eardrums, but he still rushed over.
target: «Recte.» Lugano, ex dolore in tympanis contusus, tamen properavit.

source: At that moment, Padre Cali, purified by the Cull, instinctively withdrew from his Wraith state and transformed back into a human to escape the ongoing damage.
target: Illo momento, Padre Cali, per Cull purgatus, ex statu Wraith instinctive recessit et in hominem se transformavit ut damnum currentem evaderet.

source: Seeing this, Amandina took a deep breath, clenched her fists, and closed her eyes.
target: Videns hoc, Amandina altum inspiravit, manus contraxit et oculos clausit.

source: She and Padre Cali entered the dream at the same time.
target: Illa et Padre Cali simul in somnium intraverunt.
